product.name: Card Issuing API
product.description: APIs for issuing virtual and physical Mastercard or VISA cards to users in Nigeria and Africa.

product.name: Tokenization
product.description: Feature enabling card use on Apple Pay or Google Pay through tokenization for security.

product.name: 3D Security
product.description: Enrollment of cards in 3D security for enhanced online transaction acceptance and security.

product.name: Profit on Interchanges
product.description: Allows businesses to earn from interchange fees on customer transactions.

product.name: Transaction Enrichment
product.description: Provides detailed information on users' spending history for improved transaction records.

product.name: Rewards as a Service
product.description: API service offering discounts, coupons, and promo codes from global merchants to improve card spend.
